title: Categorical Missing Value Imputation Strategy
description: Techniques for imputing missing categorical attributes without introducing category imbalance.
conditions: Nominal or ordinal categorical columns with missing entries
Downstream consumers require dense categorical vectors
Missingness is either non-informative or structurally significant
recommended_methods: Mode frequency replacement for low missingness (< 2%)
Predictive classification imputation using decision trees
selection_rules: If missingness > 3%, always impute with an explicit 'Unknown' category token
If missingness < 2% and dominant category frequency > 70%, mode imputation is safe
If ordinal category, use median ordinal level rather than mode
limitations: Mode imputation can severely distort entropy in balanced categorical features
Adding 'Unknown' token can introduce an artificial predictive feature in ML models
